comment: Vendor provenance lock. Anyone auditing this repo can re-fetch each vendored file at the exact URL below and confirm the SHA-256 matches. Run scripts/verify-vendor.sh to automate this check.

packages.name: jszip
packages.purpose: ZIP extraction in the browser. Tower's receipt artifact is a ZIP; we use JSZip to read it client-side. JSZip has no transitive dependencies and is a single self-contained file.

explicitly_not_vendored.name: javascript-opentimestamps
explicitly_not_vendored.reason: The npm package is CommonJS-only with deep Node.js stdlib usage (url, util, assert, request-promise, bitcore-lib). Bundling for browser requires polyfills and balloons the audit surface to ~250KB. We instead implement the OTS file format directly in src/verify-core.js — ~120 lines, fully auditable, zero supply-chain risk. The format is well-documented at https://github.com/opentimestamps/python-opentimestamps/blob/master/doc/file-format.md and the Bitcoin attestation path is small (append/prepend/sha256/fork ops + a single attestation tag).
